story-context.title: Component Platform Hardening + Image-to-Form Vision Path
story-context.overview: Two tracks in one story (Tony-approved, same pattern as 6.5d). Track 0 closes 6.5d process gaps: checklist v1.3 (§0c), verify_edf_props_wired.py, per-component closeout matrix template, optional EDF polish and AI EDF prompt hints. Track 1 adds multimodal image input → FormSemanticPlan → existing deterministic compiler (6.3.1 path unchanged from semantic plan onward). Uses GPT-5 mini vision; registry-backed prompt blocks; canvas dimensions preserved on replace (feasibility §2.6).
